CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) and its organization/origin are both explicitly stated for the same referent/time, and status information (origin) is distinguished.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing-condition claim linked to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content sets (red and blue) with coordinates.

D.rationale: Content (coordinate sets) is presented separately from status/metadata (origin), distinguishing identification from organization/status.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are presented/organized (grid orientation) and includes origin metadata describing presentation provenance.
